__center_block.css: display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; width: fit-content;
__center_block.label: Center Block
__center_block.purpose: Center a block element using auto margins
__center_block.restrictions: Width must be fit-content or explicit

__float_left.label: Float Left
__float_left.purpose: Float element to the left with right margin
__float_left.restrictions: May not work within certain containers

__float_right.label: Float Right
__float_right.purpose: Float element to the right with left margin
__float_right.restrictions: May not work within certain containers

__bgcolor.label: Bg Color:
__bgcolor.purpose: Set background color for a block
__bgcolor.restrictions: Must be a valid CSS color
__bgcolor.result: Paragraph with light gray background and padding

__border.label: Border
__border.purpose: Add a border around a block
__border.result: Text with border and rounded corners

__shadow.label: Shadow
__shadow.purpose: Add a shadow effect to a block
__shadow.result: Card with shadow and rounded corners

__margin.label: Margin:
__margin.result: Paragraph with 2rem margin and light background

__margin_vertical.label: Margin Vertical:
__margin_vertical.purpose: Set top and bottom margin (horizontal margins 0)
__margin_vertical.result: Paragraph with 1.5rem top and bottom margin

__margin_horizontal.label: Margin Horizontal:
__margin_horizontal.purpose: Set left and right margin (vertical margins 0)
__margin_horizontal.result: Paragraph with 10% left and right margin

__padding_vertical.label: Padding Vertical:
__padding_vertical.purpose: Set top and bottom padding (horizontal padding 0)

__padding_horizontal.label: Padding Horizontal:
__padding_horizontal.purpose: Set left and right padding (vertical padding 0)

__width.label: Width:
__width.purpose: Set width of a block element

__height.label: Height:
__height.purpose: Set height of a block element

__max_height.label: Max Height:
__max_height.result: Box with max height and scroll

__text_align_justify.label: Justify
__text_align_justify.purpose: Justify text alignment (even spacing between words)
__text_align_justify.restrictions: Works best with longer text blocks

__column_rule.label: Column Rule:
__column_rule.restrictions: Must be valid CSS column-rule value
__column_rule.result: Two columns with dashed separator line

__flex_center.css: display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
__flex_center.label: Flex Center
__flex_center.purpose: Center items both horizontally and vertically using flexbox
__flex_center.result: Text centered both ways in 200px container

__flex_column.label: Flex Column
__flex_column.purpose: Arrange flex items in a column (vertical)

__absolute.label: Absolute
__absolute.purpose: Position element absolutely (requires parent with relative)

__relative.label: Relative
__relative.purpose: Set position: relative (anchor for absolute children)

__sticky.label: Sticky
__sticky.purpose: Make element stick to top when scrolling
__sticky.result: Element sticks to top when scrolling

__z_index.label: Z-Index:
__z_index.purpose: Control stacking order of positioned elements

__opacity.label: Opacity:
__opacity.purpose: Set transparency (0 = fully transparent, 1 = fully opaque)

__hanging_indent.label: Hanging Indent
__hanging_indent.purpose: Create a hanging indent (first line pulled left)
__hanging_indent.example: {[__hanging_indent]} [[First line starts left, subsequent lines are indented]]

__first_line_indent.label: First Line Indent
__first_line_indent.purpose: Indent only the first line of text by 2em

__outdent.label: Outdent
__outdent.purpose: Outdent content (pull left with compensation on right)
__outdent.result: Content shifted left 2em with 2em right padding

__safe.label: Safe Margins
__safe.purpose: Apply safe margins that avoid arrows and navigation elements

__ibgcolor.label: Bg Color:
__ibgcolor.purpose: Set background color for inline-block element

__iborder.css: border: 1px solid currentColor; padding: 0.5em; box-sizing: border-box;
__iborder.label: Border

__irounded.css: border-radius: 8px; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
__irounded.label: Rounded
__irounded.purpose: Add rounded corners with semi-transparent background and blur to inline-block

__iwidth.css: width: {value}; min-width: {value}; max-width: {value}; overflow: hidden; box-sizing: border-box;
__iwidth.label: Width:
__iwidth.purpose: Set width with overflow hidden on inline-block
__iwidth.result: Inline-block with fixed width and hidden overflow

__imax_height.label: Max Height:
__imax_height.result: Inline-block with max height and scroll

__ihanging_indent.label: Hanging Indent
__ihanging_indent.purpose: Create hanging indent in inline-block text

__ifirst_line_indent.label: First Line Indent
__ifirst_line_indent.purpose: Indent only first line of inline-block text by 2em

_box.label: Box
_box.purpose: Wrap text in a box (border + padding)

_fontsize.label: Font Size:
_fontsize.purpose: Set exact font size in rem units

_bgcolor.label: Bg Color:
_bgcolor.purpose: Set background color for inline text

_clickme_str.label: ClickMe
_clickme_str.purpose: Make text clickable with glass button style
_clickme_str.restrictions: Must be used with ClickWord or similar

_tab.label: Tab
_tab.purpose: Add a tab (2em margin-left) to text

_letter_spacing.label: Letter Spacing:
_letter_spacing.result: E x p a n d e d
